name: Echoes of a Winter Past
source:
In the heart of the holiday season, immerse yourself in an enchanting tale of an extraordinary visitor from a distant world. "Echoes of a Winter Past" invites you on a captivating journey as an artificial life form, originally bound for a distant galaxy, finds herself inadvertently stranded on Earth during the festive period.

Amidst the bone chilling winter, our visitor, initially determined to return home swiftly, encounters a series of unforeseen events that draw her into an unexpected bond with a warm-hearted family. At odds with her longing to escape the unfamiliar planet, she becomes entangled in the heartwarming traditions and the genuine warmth of the holiday spirit.

As she navigates the unfamiliar but genuine kindness of the family, our protagonist experiences a transformation of heart. 

[From [url=https://deukron.itch.io/echoes-of-a-winter-past]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
正逢佳節，一位來自遙遠世界的特別訪客降臨了。《Echoes of a Winter Past》將帶你踏上一段奇妙的旅程：一名原本要前往遙遠星系的人造生命體意外偏離航線，在節日期間滯留地球。

寒冬刺骨，她一心想盡快回家，卻因一連串意外與一戶熱心人家結下了緣分。她很想逃離這顆陌生的星球，卻又不由自主地融入了當地溫馨的節日習俗，感受到人們過節時流露的真情。

這家人的善意讓她有些不知所措。學著與他們相處的日子裡，她的心意也在悄然改變。

（來源：[url=https://deukron.itch.io/echoes-of-a-winter-past]itch.io[/url]）
